title: Conditions on the On-Site Attendances a Plan Year Absorbs under the Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Conditions on the On-Site Attendances a Plan Year Absorbs under the Building Automation Service Plans

**Condition 1.** Where the building carries a maintenance agreement standing active whose tier includes remote monitoring of covered equipment, the plan year of the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans absorbs two on-site attendances beyond the tier's included on-site visits.

**Condition 2.** Where the building carries a maintenance agreement standing active whose tier does not include remote monitoring of covered equipment, the plan year absorbs one on-site attendance beyond the tier's included on-site visits.

**Condition 3.** In every other case the plan year absorbs the tier's included on-site visits.

The agreement, its standing and whether its tier includes remote monitoring of covered equipment are read from the office's records of Preventive Maintenance Agreements written against that building.

| Maintenance agreement at the building standing active | That agreement's tier includes remote monitoring of covered equipment | Attendances the plan year absorbs |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the tier's included on-site visits and 2 attendances beyond them |
| yes | no | the tier's included on-site visits and 1 attendance beyond it |
| no | not read | the tier's included on-site visits |

**Worked case (hypothetical).** A plan whose tier includes 2 on-site visits a plan year, at a building carrying an agreement under the Preventive Maintenance Agreements standing active whose tier includes remote monitoring of covered equipment, absorbs 2 plus 2, that is 4 attendances. At a building whose active agreement's tier does not include remote monitoring, it absorbs 2 plus 1, that is 3 attendances. With no agreement standing active, it absorbs the tier's 2 attendances.
